C9000232.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 232 (Gaussian fields and interfaces for triangular-lattice Lipschitz heights.; papers: Gaussian free-field limits of weighted integer Lipschitz heights; The Gaussian free field limit of integer Lipschitz heights with two-arc boundary data; Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

W232-MAIN.statement: Weighted manuscript thm:main: for fixed x in [1/sqrt(2),1], zero-boundary integer 1-Lipschitz heights in the stated smooth simply connected domains converge, after division by a positive domain-independent sigma(x), to the Dirichlet GFF, including all mixed test-function moments.

W232-PLANE-INPUTS.statement: Weighted prop:local-mixing, prop:plane-moments, prop:reflection-transfer and plane:lem:spectrum supply the stationary plane law, moment control, positive transfer, and invariant annularly bounded punctured spectrum. Model applicability is not proved by the abstract spectral implication.

W232-POSITIVITY.statement: Weighted lem:nondegeneracy supplies the positive variance lower bound needed to upgrade the abstract spectral coefficient c >= 0 to c > 0.

W232-PINS.statement: Weighted prop:reflection-null, prop:bracket-collapse and prop:bracket-insertion transfer the plane Laplace insertion through pinning brackets to bounded domains.

W232-WICK.statement: Weighted prop:smearing, prop:collision and thm:wick identify limiting higher moments and Gaussianity after the pin transfer.

T232-MAIN.statement: Two-arc manuscript thm:main: uniform odd integer heights with adjacent differences 0 or 2 and +/-1 marked arc boundary data converge to the harmonic extension of that data plus sigma times the Dirichlet GFF, with all mixed test-function moments and sigma = 4*pi*sqrt(c_*), under its stated approximation hypotheses.

T232-PLANE-INPUTS.statement: Two-arc prop:plane-mixing, prop:plane-moments, prop:reflection-positivity, lem:increment-spectral, lem:annulus-mass and prop:cauchy-mixture supply the spectral hypotheses.

T232-POSITIVITY.statement: Two-arc lem:buffer-circuits and lem:component-switch supply a strictly positive variance lower bound; prop:normalization-series identifies the normalization.

T232-PINS.statement: Two-arc cor:reflection-null and prop:bracket-identity transfer the spectral Laplace identity to the bounded-domain boundary comparison brackets.

T232-MOMENTS.statement: Two-arc prop:smearing-moments, prop:tightness and prop:collision-coefficient identify Gaussian limiting moments and distributional convergence.

R232-MAIN.statement: Real manuscript thm:main: uniform real-valued triangular-lattice 1-Lipschitz surfaces with the stated +/-lambda marked boundary data have a centered Dirichlet-GFF limit and a chordal SLE_4 interface limit, with sigma^2 = 1/(v*A) and lambda^2 = pi/(8*v*A). This is separate from the integer spectral mechanism.

R232-COMPARISON.statement: Real prop:f:averages and thm:c:comparison supply macroscopic moment control and synchronous reflected coupling.

R232-RESPONSE.statement: Real prop:b:response identifies the tangent-flux coefficient A and small-tilt response.

R232-GFF.statement: Real thm:b:gff identifies the bulk GFF with stiffness v*A.

R232-COVARIANCE.statement: Real thm:t:covariance and cor:t:local-boundary-variance identify conditional covariance and local boundary variance.

R232-INTERFACE.statement: Real prop:g:barriers, prop:g:sample-comparison, prop:g:nonreturn, prop:h:height-gap and prop:h:stopped establish the height-gap and stopped harmonic observable identifying SLE_4.

S232-RIGIDITY.statement: A positive locally finite punctured triangular reciprocal-torus measure with all original rotation/reflection symmetries, a uniform small-annulus mass bound and the stated positive periodized-Cauchy mixtures in the three row charts has a full unique scaling limit c*|p|^(-2)dp, c >= 0. No strict positivity or Gaussian higher moments is asserted.

S232-EXCEPTIONS.statement: From the positive mixtures and triangular rotations, remove physical tangential zero lines and the reciprocal alias atom, and derive integral |k| dnu < infinity. Weighted plane:lem:mixture; two-arc prop:cauchy-mixture and lem:endcap.

S232-DEFECT.statement: The fourth-harmonic Cauchy identity, uniform periodization error and the negative-cap argument imply integral D(k,s)dnu < infinity and uniform dyadic horizontal-band masses. Weighted plane:lem:defect; two-arc lem:angular-poisson and prop:dispersion-defect.

S232-ENDCAP.statement: Rotating a cap into a chart with both coordinates away from zero gives C{b<|p|<=2b,|k|<=h} <= K*h/b and prevents rescaled exceptional-line mass. Weighted lem:endcaps; two-arc lem:endcap.

S232-TANGENTS.statement: Summable defect forces limiting mixtures onto s=|k|; two independent chart-normal distributional derivatives force |p|^2*M to be constant on the connected punctured plane. Weighted plane:lem:subsequences; two-arc lem:spectral-subsequences.

S232-UNIQUE.statement: A full scalar cutoff limit L exists before subsequence selection, endcaps justify its noncompact rescaled limit, and L = -pi*c/2 determines c uniquely. Weighted plane:lem:unique; two-arc prop:angular-sum.

S232-STABILITY.statement: The shared spectral rigidity implication remains true when each of the three exact positive periodized-Cauchy mixtures is perturbed by an arbitrary finite signed chart error, including atoms. The full scaling limit is c*|p|^(-2)dp, 0 <= c <= K/(2*pi*log(2)), with c=-2*(L+B_0)/pi and B_0 the finite physical exceptional-line mass weighted by the radial cutoff. No common simultaneous correction of the three mixtures is assumed.

S232-FINITE-ERRORS.statement: Under the finite-error hypotheses, weighted mixing mass and dispersion defect remain summable, exceptional physical lines have finite mass, and endcaps have the bound 6*B*h/b plus the rotated error variation. Deleting the central line makes the summed error corridors decrease to the empty set, even for atomic errors. Tangential-band scaling eliminates both finite errors and punctured alias neighborhoods.

S232-LINE-CORRECTION.statement: For finite signed chart errors the full raw scalar limit L exists, but the coefficient is c=-2*(L+B_0)/pi, where B_0=integral_{k=0}Q dC is finite. B_0=0 for the original exact-mixture hypotheses. The six-point atomic orbit proves that omitting B_0 in the larger class gives an incorrect coefficient.

S232-ATOMIC-WITNESS.statement: The six unit atoms at R_{pi/3}^j(0,1/8), j=0,...,5, are D6 invariant, have zero spectral tangent, raw cutoff limit -2, and exceptional-line counterterm +2 when Q=1 on their radius. They refute only the uncorrected extension to finite spectral errors, not an original manuscript statement.
